name: PQ-10 End-to-End Shadow Lifecycle
objective: Prove that the post-quantum migration path can complete a deterministic behavioral lifecycle entirely in isolated shadow state without changing active FAE.
selection_rule: Run all three ML-DSA hybrid parameter sets. PQ-09 measurements do not automatically select an operational winner.
lifecycle: create ephemeral test recovery material at runtime; never commit or emit mnemonic/passphrase/private keys
derive legacy Ed25519 identity and shadow PQ material
build a PQ-05 hybrid shadow transaction
canonical serialize and derive deterministic shadow txid
submit only to an isolated in-memory shadow mempool
persist only public metadata, signed transaction and non-secret shadow state
simulate process restart and reload the frozen public artifact
re-verify transaction and wallet public metadata after restart
replay the frozen PQ-07 regression corpus against the restarted verifier
exercise browser-facing implementation compatibility without claiming physical-device performance
deterministic_replay_definition: The operation schedule, admitted public artifacts, txid, verdicts and post-restart state transitions must reproduce within a run; reusable secret material must not be stored as evidence.
isolated_shadow_mempool_rules: no RPC or active backend submission
no mutation of active Transaction v2 mempool/state
invalid or stripped transaction rejected before mutation
restart reconstruction from public shadow artifact is deterministic
gate: All three ML-DSA lifecycle variants complete create/recover/sign/serialize/shadow-submit/restart/reload/verify/regression replay with frozen public evidence and zero active-network authority.
